thread:
Elena (PM): quick: small follow-up on the Usage grid mock. two bits: legend placement for narrow widths, and where to show invoice downloads. figma: https://figma.com/file/mini
Maya (Design): propose legend in right column desktop, collapse to an icon that opens a full-width sheet on mobile. sheet includes CSV export and legend items.
Ben (Frontend): sheet + icon works. will add keyboard focus/aria-controls. prefer lazy-loading sheet content to save DOM.
Aldo (Data): CSV shape: date, project_id (if team scoped), token_type, model, tokens_consumed, cost_usd, invoice_id. will add series_priority to API so charts render in billing order.
Sasha (Eng): note: the tooltip currently hits a heavy real-time endpoint for cache stats. switch to pre-aggregated telemetry and prefix with "Estimated".
Maya (Design): accessibility: a11y-bot flagged contrast <4.5:1 for small legend labels. I'll darken text and include an optional patterned fill toggle.
a11y-bot: recommend label color #1f2937 for small text and patterns toggle for colorblind users.
Elena (PM): decision: global download button + conditional per-row "Download invoice" when invoice_exists=true. mobile sheet shows the export CTA too. I'll collect PRs and schedule a short sign-off next Tue.
Maya (Design): will push updated frames and tag here.
Ben (Frontend): branch started, will prototype sheet and lazy invoice buttons.
Sasha (Eng): prepping telemetry change.
Aldo (Data): posting CSV OpenAPI in #api-design shortly.
Elena (PM): thanks team, great progress.
